name: iotaps-web
description: IoTAPS frontend SPA (React + Vite, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Redux Toolkit)

scripts.predev: node scripts/optimize-images.mjs || node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='src/lib/marketingImages.generated.js';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){fs.writeFileSync(p,'// AUTO-GENERATED fallback: web/public/marketing JPEG sources were unavailable at predev, so no optimized variants or manifest were built. Plain /marketing/*.jpg fallbacks still render.\nexport const marketingImageManifest = {};\n');console.log('[predev] wrote empty marketingImages.generated.js (sources missing); run npm run images once public/marketing/*.jpg exist')}else{console.log('[predev] images manifest kept as-is')}"
scripts.build: node scripts/optimize-images.mjs && vite build && node scripts/generate-seo.mjs --out dist && node scripts/prerender.mjs --out dist
scripts.seo: node scripts/generate-seo.mjs --out dist && node scripts/prerender.mjs --out dist
